description: Drinking water fountains managed by the Brussels-Capital Region and located on the territory of the City of Brussels or nearby (source: Vivaqua) is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Drinking water fountains managed by the Brussels-Capital Region and located on the territory of the City of Brussels or nearby (source: Vivaqua) This dataset only contains active fountains reported by Vivaqua. More info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Public space. Its keywords are Water, Fountain, free, station, drinkable, freshness. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
